features.feature: Analyzer reads batch-ledger.jsonl (H1/H4 source)
Analyzer reads tamper-verdicts.jsonl (H2 source)
Analyzer reads resume-reconciliation.json (H3 source)
Analyzer reads protocol.json (fingerprints, cross-product, env pins)
H1 adjudication: pairwise digest equality across replay proof records per scale, three-state incl. not-evaluable on any stop record
H2 adjudication: per-class fingerprint match against protocol.json, three-state incl. not-evaluable on harness precondition failure
H3 adjudication: identity-multiset reconciliation (0 dup/0 gap), casualty resolves to stop-or-rerun
H4 adjudication: cap-vs-stop accounting (silent breach without stop record = falsified)
report.json emitted
report.md (human-readable) emitted
Analyzer is offline-only: reads ONLY committed ledger/protocol files, never re-executes the instrument or calls the lattice CLI
Per-record recordDigest re-derivation runs FIRST; any mismatch aborts the verdict with a named record id
Report content digest = sha256(canonicalJson(report minus digest field))
Digest reproducibility: re-running analyzer on same ledger reproduces the same report digest (byte-identical report.json/report.md)
No-overclaim text: section 3 claim text embedded verbatim in report.md, ONLY if all four hypotheses are supported
If any hypothesis falsified/not-evaluable, report states it plainly with the machine-readable reason (three-state reporting)
Final summary lists any instrument defect found by the campaign
Hermetic selfcheck-m4.mjs (mkdtemp-isolated) proving the three-state logic is un-gameable
Selfcheck asserts tampered/truncated/missing/insufficient evidence yields inconclusive or fail, NEVER a false pass
Cross-host replication: Codex independently re-runs analyze-batch.mjs against the committed ledger and reproduces the report digest
Scale envelope reporting in report.json/report.md (elapsed / endOfRunRss per section 7 artifact table)
Adversarial ledger integrity (cryptographic signing / defeating a self-recomputing editor) is out of scope — Tier-C, not this milestone
features.excluded_by: spec section 3 claim boundary: adversarial ledger integrity is explicitly Tier-C, referenced not implemented here
